#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run only the public sanity fixture, with a bounded local subprocess."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / 'submission/bridge.py')],
                      input=(root / 'examples/scenario.json').read_bytes(),
                      stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=30)
if proc.returncode:
    print('Program failed:', proc.stderr[:2000].decode('utf-8', 'replace'), file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)
try:
    actual = json.loads(proc.stdout)
except (ValueError, UnicodeError):
    print('Program did not produce one JSON result.', file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)
expected = json.loads((root / 'examples/expected.json').read_bytes())
if actual != expected:
    print('Public example differs. Compare your result with examples/expected.json.', file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)
print('Public example passed: 6 streams, 3 forwarded requests, 3 origin pipelines.')
